import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Create a figure with two subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(14, 12))
plt.suptitle('Credit Card Transaction Analysis: Fraudulent vs. Non-Fraudulent', fontsize=16, y=1.02)

# --- Subplot 1: Transaction Amount Distribution by Type and Fraud Status ---
sns.violinplot(
    data=df,
    x='transaction_type',
    y='amount',
    hue='is_fraud',
    split=True,
    ax=axes[0],
    palette='Set2',
    inner='quartile', # Show quartiles for better understanding of distribution
    hue_order=[0, 1]
)
axes[0].set_title('Transaction Amount Distribution by Type and Fraud Status', fontsize=14)
axes[0].set_xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=12)
axes[0].set_ylabel('Transaction Amount', fontsize=12)
# Customize legend for clarity
handles, labels = axes[0].get_legend_handles_labels()
axes[0].legend(handles=handles, labels=['No Fraud', 'Fraud'], title='Is Fraud', title_fontsize='13', fontsize='11')
axes[0].tick_params(axis='x', labelsize=10)
axes[0].tick_params(axis='y', labelsize=10)


# --- Subplot 2: Transaction Frequency by Hour of Day and Fraud Status ---
sns.countplot(
    data=df,
    x='hour_of_day',
    hue='is_fraud',
    ax=axes[1],
    palette='Set2',
    hue_order=[0, 1]
)
axes[1].set_title('Transaction Frequency by Hour of Day and Fraud Status', fontsize=14)
axes[1].set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=12)
axes[1].set_ylabel('Number of Transactions', fontsize=12)
# Customize legend for clarity
handles, labels = axes[1].get_legend_handles_labels()
axes[1].legend(handles=handles, labels=['No Fraud', 'Fraud'], title='Is Fraud', title_fontsize='13', fontsize='11')
axes[1].tick_params(axis='x', labelsize=10)
axes[1].tick_params(axis='y', labelsize=10)


plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.98]) # Adjust layout to make space for suptitle

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
